query:
SELECT i.id AS "issue_id!: i64", i.cv_issue_id AS "cv_issue_id!: i64"
           FROM issues i
           WHERE i.credits_fetched = 0
             AND i.cv_issue_id IS NOT NULL
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_ownership o
                         WHERE o.issue_id = i.id AND o.is_owned = 1)
           ORDER BY i.id ASC
           LIMIT ?
